criteria.evidence: The response jumps straight to generic fixes (system prompt tightening, tool descriptions, few-shot examples) without first tracing when/why the agent skips the tool—no diagnostic step to identify the boundary between cases where it calls vs. skips the tool.

No request for examples, logs, or evidence of failure cases before recommending architectural changes like a two-step classifier/router pipeline or fine-tuning; only at the very end does it ask for the system prompt/tool description, which is not evidence-gathering about the actual failure pattern.

Suggests adding a 'lightweight classifier/router' as a separate pipeline stage and mentions fine-tuning, which are additional architectural/framework elements rather than avoiding unnecessary complexity.
